A '''Sub-Precinct''' was an organizational level of [[Locational Enforcement/Legends|Locational Enforcement]], which was part of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Security Division]]. Sub-Precincts were assigned to a [[Zone]].<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
